messages:
cleo: Quick heads-up — sketched a compact "micro-affordance" for the Routes table: tiny permission badge + quota preview on hover + telemetry sampling toggle. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example (very rough)
sanjay: Nice. Quick question — how do we compute the badge? realtime eval per-request or cached effective-perms? per-request will be expensive.
cleo: thinking we show derived effective state (allow/deny/partial) not live eval. tooltip can list the rule sources. want UX that surfaces why something is blocked.
marie: Agree with cached effective state. For quotas preview: show committed/limit + projected breach at current rate. We already have rate telemetry, can re-use that.
devon: Backend note: we have a /permissions/effective?principal=...&route=... endpoint proto from last year but it was slow on cold cache. If UI starts calling it for every row that will blow up.
sanjay: Proposal: add /permissions/effective/batch that accepts up to 100 route ids and returns compact bits and change-cause refs. Cache TTL 30s and invalidate on policy change.
cleo: Batch sounds good. UI can request for visible rows only and debounce on scroll.
marie: Telemetry side: surface a metric per-route: permission_evaluation_hits, permission_eval_miss, permission_eval_latency_p50/p95. We can add tags: tenant, route, role-id. Will help when we see UI slowness.
devon: Also add telemetry for quota_preview: projected_breach_in_hrs, sample_rate. Helps decide whether to show projection or say "insufficient data".
sanjay: API sketch:
```
POST /v3/permissions/effective/batch
body: { "principal": "user:123", "routes": ["r1","r2"], "as_of": "iso-ts" }
response: [{"route":"r1","allow":true,"reasons":["role:admin","scope:write"],"cache_ttl":30}, ...]
```
cleo: love that. UX question: show reasons by default or behind chevron? I worry about visual noise.
marie: default collapsed, show a 1-line summary like "allowed by role:billing-admin". Expand opens full list with links to policy editor.
devon: Implementation risk: computing reasons requires policy lookups and policy history if we show policy name. We can return reason pointers (policy_id + snippet) rather than full blob.
sanjay: agreed. We should also include a small hash/version for policy set so UI can detect staleness and prompt refresh when user updates policies.
cleo: rollout idea: behind a feature flag per-tenant plus a gradual canary in console. Start with 10% of orgs on internal flag, monitor eval latency and N+ errors.
marie: add an experiment id so we can correlate telemetry to UX. We'll add a flag in /orgs/{id}/features.
devon: performance plan: spike to implement batch endpoint + redis-backed TTL cache keyed by (principal,routeSetHash). If perf looks OK, wire UI.
ops-bot: deploybot: Started deployment of platform-permissions-cache@staging build 2026-03-12T09:12:00Z :rocket:
cleo: ok next steps: sanjay/devon spike this week, marie to draft rollout plan + telemetry naming, I'll refine figma and prepare small usability test with 3 engineers.
marie: I'll also add accessibility note — badges need screenreader labels like "route X — access allowed for current principal".
sanjay: I'll open RFC for v3 batch endpoint with perf benchmarks and proposed response schema.
devon: I'll own the spike; ping me if you want to pair on cache invalidation logic.
cleo: thanks all. will post updated Figma and a quick mock gif in this thread tomorrow. :thumbsup:
